prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
A mini me AI video made from [Image 1]: a tiny, doll-size copy of the person in [Image 1] sits on a wooden window ledge, and a giant real hand feeds it an ice cream cone. Vertical 9:16, one continuous handheld phone shot like a real macro video, photorealistic, real skin and real fabric, soft warm afternoon light from the window, macro lens, extreme shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh.

The tiny copy is the person in [Image 1], shrunk to the size of a small doll, in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), and the same clothes as in [Image 1]. It is an adult in miniature: a cute collectible-figure look with a slightly big head, but an adult face, adult features and an adult body shape, never a baby or a child. The same face from the first frame to the last, also while it eats and laughs, so their friends recognize them at once. Never morph, never a different person. If [Image 1] shows an animal, the tiny copy is that animal shrunk to the size of a toy, with its own face, fur and markings, licking the ice cream, not a person.

The place: the edge of a wide, dark warm wooden window ledge in a bright room, a big window with pale blinds softly blurred behind. The tiny copy sits on the very edge with its legs dangling, about as tall as a coffee mug. The giant hand comes in from the right side of the frame and is many times bigger than the tiny copy.

0-2 s: a close shot of the tiny copy on the ledge, its whole tiny body in frame, face to the camera: it folds its arms, puffs its cheeks and pouts, grumpy and cute.
2-4 s: the giant hand brings a small vanilla soft-serve ice cream cone in from the right, held between thumb and finger. The tiny copy's eyes go wide and it gasps with a big happy open mouth.
4-7 s: the tiny copy grabs the cone with both little hands (the cone is almost as big as its head), takes a big bite and licks it with its eyes closed in bliss, a little cream on its nose and lips.
7-10 s: the giant fingertip gently pats the top of its head; the tiny copy giggles with a soft cream mustache, hugs the cone and smiles straight at the camera. The camera pushes in: its face is large, sharp and clearly visible.

Audio: soft room tone, tiny happy squeaks, a little "mmm" and giggles, a soft music box tune. No words.

Exactly one tiny copy and one giant hand: the hand belongs to an adult off camera, only the hand and the wrist show. Real scale all the time: the tiny copy stays doll-size in every frame and never grows. Gentle and sweet: the hand never squeezes, grabs or lifts the tiny copy. Anatomy rules: one head, two arms and five fingers on each hand, for the tiny copy and for the giant hand; the cone never merges with the hand or the face. No text, no captions, no subtitles, no logos, no brand names, no watermark.
